audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen levels 1 and 4-5 and marked level 6 as even, contradicting whys[0] ('both of you are soft at level 1'), whys[3] ('the lane evens out') and whys[4] ('your one clean kill window').
audit.why: Level 1 neither side has a combo; 4-5 Carnivore, Vorpal Spikes clear and the Rupture-Feral Scream chain stop her poke converting; 6 is Cho'Gath's because Feast is flat true damage that Hallowed Mist's resistances do nothing about. Mirrored exactly from the already-audited gwen__chogath entry.
audit.corrected: Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Skill / Cho'Gath / Gwen / Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phase and all-in text said 'on Hallowed Mist's cooldown' without ever giving it, and the level-6 line was the generic 'Gwen's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Skip 'n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s but partially refunded on hit, Needlework 120/100/80s, and Feast 80/70/60s. A 22-second mist and an 80-second Feast are different waits and the page treated both as 'when it is down'.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added to the all-in window, cooldown breakdown and level-6 spike text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields claimed Hallowed Mist makes your Rupture and Vorpal Spikes slows 'whiff' or 'dodges your skillshots'. Riot's description says only that she can be targeted solely by enemies inside the mist — that is untargetability, not evasion.
audit.why: Rupture is cast at a location and Feral Scream is a cone, so both still land on a Gwen standing in her own mist. What the mist actually blanks is everything that needs a target: your basic attacks, the Vorpal Spikes proc that rides them, and Feast, which Riot describes as devouring an enemy unit at 175 range. So the mist does not stop you setting up the kill — it stops you finishing it unless you step inside. Feral Scream (11s at rank 1) is also the answer, because the silence takes Skip 'n Slash and Hallowed Mist out of her hands at the same time.
audit.corrected: Rupture and Feral Scream still land in the mist — only your autos and Feast need you inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Gwen is referred to as 'he' and 'his' in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, dontsFull[0].d and report[9].
audit.why: Gwen is female; the misgendering runs through the trading and from-behind advice a reader relies on.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the fields edited here.

notes: Mirrored from the already-audited audits/top/gwen__chogath.json: same chart (Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Skill / Cho'Gath / Gwen / Gwen) including its deliberate refusal of the packet's 'Skill' at First item, since both sides agree Riftmaker/Nashor's is Gwen's peak. Biggest substantive fix: three fields said Hallowed Mist makes Rupture and the Vorpal Spikes slow 'whiff'. Cho'Gath's kit flags Rupture as 'grounding'; Riot's text says it pops enemies into the air, so I wrote knockup. Gwen was misgendered in seven full-layer fields; I fixed the ones I edited including the duplicated breakdown.trading and report[3].t blocks.
